options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: included_campaigns
options.description: Campaigns that are guaranteed to be included

options.name: additional_campaigns
options.description: Number of additional randomly selected campaigns to add to the included campaigns

options.name: required_campaigns
options.description: The number of campaigns where the final scenario must be completed in order to goal

options.name: starting_scenarios
options.description: The number of scenarios that will start unlocked

options.name: starting_investigators
options.description: The number of investigators that will start unlocked

options.name: xp_logic_modifier
options.description: The value all logically expected xp for scenarios will be multiplied with, as percent

options.name: difficulty
options.description: The difficulty used for campaigns. This affects which filler and trap items exist in the pool and is intended to be matched to the difficulty selected for each campaign.
